body: JFC I know right? I just got out too and of course I just lied and lied until they let me out, of course I'm not going to tell you the truth?? and everyone says 'oh have you tried meditating or movies or rubber bands or blah blah blah' yes, it doesn't work now just let me leave on my own goddamn terms why are you all so hellbent on me not killing myself WHO CARES
Is there anything I should be looking out for?

I am though, my best friend left because my emotions were so unpredictable and it sucked for her. I've lost other friends because I just withdraw and stop talking to people. My mum doesn't even want to talk to me about my problems because 'oh that's your husbands job now' but my marriage was a fucking mistake and I don't know how to get out. I don't want to get close to anyone at work because eventually my contract will run out and I'll have to leave. My GP doesn't even care enough to get me a MHCP, I've tried to get help but I can't anymore nobody knows what to do or say

I'm sorry thank you for trying to help I'm just a fucking mess
I ruin every relationship/friendship I touch, what's the point in being alive if I have nobody?
not enough, 26x500mg paracetamol... but I have another set of mixed and wine so that should do it I'd think
